claim: In the serverless versus node-based comparison, serverless caching supports Valkey 7.2 and higher, Redis OSS version 7.1 and Memcached 1.6.22 and higher. Node-based clusters support Valkey 7.2 and higher, Redis OSS version 4.0 to 7.1 and Memcached 1.4 and higher.
question: Which engine versions do ElastiCache Serverless and node-based clusters support?

values.display: Valkey 7.2 and higher, Redis OSS version 7.1, Memcached 1.6.22 and higher
values.spoken: Valkey seven point two and higher, Redis OSS seven point one, Memcached one point six point twenty-two and higher
Redis OSS four point zero to seven point one

note: The FAQ (question 'What is ElastiCache Serverless?') says Memcached 1.4.5 and above and Redis OSS 4.0.10 to 7.1 for Serverless; the guide table above is used as current truth and the FAQ wording is recorded here, not added as a competing fact.
